timing_variance.interpretation: Same code, same inputs, 60% spread on phase durations. Timing metrics cannot be used for regression detection without N>=3 replications.

analysis.key_insight: Memory behavior is deterministic; timing behavior is highly stochastic. The benchmark harness can be trusted for gate pass/fail and memory ceilings but not for speed regression detection at single-run granularity.
